data.title: Smerconish: the AI ‘discombobulation’ trajectory | CNN
data.description: Smerconish is joined by Joseph Turow, professor and author of “The Problem with Personalization”, a new book that highlights a new, under-explored threat of AI–its potential to hyperpersonalize ads, social media posts, and more to each of us.
data.author: Suha Musa
